question_text: We cannot open or close a door by applying force at the hinges. Why?

verification.note: Sri Chaitanya IPE Junior Fastrack (Rev. May 2024), Unit 7 VERY SHORT ANSWER. The 1+1 split is invented and needs a Telangana IPE teacher. AP appearance: asked on the AP Inter 1st-year Physics paper, March 2026 (Section B, the first paper of the new 85-mark NCERT pattern) — transcription evidence, claim until the official paper PDF confirms the question number.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The formula
lines: The turning effect of a force is the
where r is the distance of the force
steps.margin_note: Define r in words — "distance from the hinge line". The next step lives on it.
steps.why: A door turns about the hinge line, so only the torque about that line matters — not the force by itself.
common_mistakes: Writing τ = rF and forgetting what r is measured from.

recall.must_convey: That the turning effect is the torque, τ = r F sin θ, with r measured from the hinges.
accept: torque is r F sin theta
reject: r is zero at the hinges

steps.memory_tip: Three factors in τ = rF sin θ. Only r changes in this question; the force does not.

steps.label: The reason
lines: At the hinges the distance r = 0, so

lines.text: τ = 0 — there is no turning effect.

lines: That is why the door will not open or
close from a push at the hinges.
steps.margin_note: Two symbols do the work: r = 0, so τ = 0. Write both.
steps.why: However large the force, multiplying it by a zero arm gives zero torque. This is also why handles sit at the far edge — the largest r the door offers.
common_mistakes: Saying the force is "absorbed by the hinges" — the force is fine; its ARM is zero.

recall.must_convey: That at the hinges r = 0 so the torque is zero and there is no turning effect.
accept: r is zero at the hinges
reject: torque is r F sin theta

steps.memory_tip: Anything multiplied by zero is zero. A 1000 N push at r = 0 still gives τ = 0.

insider_note: The second mark is one line of symbols — r = 0, so τ = 0. An answer in words alone does not reach it.
